said.q: At the same time, however, the number of bold figure-ground contrasts is reduced, to achieve greater force, and the surrounding materials are kept closer to each other tonally
Collages of that date are sober, dignified, highly geometric compositions

acts.t: De Kooning: A Retrospective, ed. David Frankel, exh. cat
acts.cite: John Elderfield et al., De Kooning: A Retrospective, ed. David Frankel, exh. cat. (New York: Museum of Modern Art, 2011), 328, pl. 116
